structure.unit: Uniform Fiduciary Income And Principal Act

text.section: If a fiduciary makes or expects to make a principal disbursement described in subsection B, the fiduciary may transfer an appropriate amount from income to principal in one or more accounting periods to reimburse principal or provide a reserve for future principal disbursements.

If an asset whose ownership gives rise to a principal disbursement becomes subject to a successive interest after an income interest ends, the fiduciary may continue to make transfers under subsection A.
